places.place_tip: Read the inscriptions on the pillar for historical insights.

places.name: Lumbini Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the art, culture, and history of the Lumbini area, including ancient artifacts and sculptures.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

attribution.title: Lumbini Buddhist pilgrimage IMG 0678 18
attribution.author: Harry Paudyal
attribution.description: Lumbinī (Nepali and Sanskrit: लुम्बिनी) is a Buddhist pilgrimage site in the Rupandehi District of Province No. 5 in Nepal. It is the place where, according to Buddhist tradition, Queen Mayadevi gave birth to Siddhartha Gautama in  BCE. Gautama, who achieved Enlightenment some time around 528 BCE became the Buddha and founded Buddhism. Lumbini is one of many magnets for pilgrimage that sprang up in places pivotal to the life of the Buddha.

places.name: Eternal Peace Flame
places.ai_summary: A flame that has been burning since 1986, symbolizing world peace, located near the Maya Devi Temple.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at dawn or dusk.

places.place_tip: Participate in the prayer ceremony for a unique experience.

attribution.author: Godot13
attribution.description: A memorial flame in honor of the residents of Nizhny Novgorod who died during World War II.

places.name: Monastic Zone
places.ai_summary: A unique area in Lumbini where monks from different countries reside and practice, featuring various monasteries and meditation centers.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the silence and rules of the monastic community.

places.place_tip: Join a meditation session for a deeper experience.
